hook.text: Not every bank has a direct relationship with every other bank. To move money internationally, they use intermediaries.

buildup.text: A small bank in Vietnam routes through a large bank in Singapore that has a relationship with a US bank.

discovery.text: Each correspondent bank adds fees and processing time. A simple transfer can pass through 3-5 banks and take 3-5 days.

twist.text: Compliance checks at each bank add more delays. Anti-money-laundering rules require each step to verify the sender.

climax.text: Correspondent banking is slow because trust must be verified at every link. Speed requires fewer links.

punchline.text: 3-5 banks, 3-5 days, 3-5 fees. Each link adds cost and time.

quiz.question: Why do international wire transfers take several days?
options: Money passes through multiple correspondent banks with compliance checks at each
